senses.gloss: to go around, go about; [b. h. to dance].
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 20:6">Gen. R. s. 20</cite>, a. e., v. <cite ref="K01202"><he>כִּרְכּוּר</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to form a circle in order to make an announcement.
units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 21:1">Pesik. R. s. 21</cite> <he>למלך שהיה עומד ומְכַרְכֵּר על וכ׳</he> like a king standing and gathering a circle around him at the entrance of his palace; <he>כך … כשעמד ומכ׳ על הר סיני</he> so the Lord when he stood addressing a meeting on Mount Sinai.
